name: B3·3 AI Sales Brain — lead scoring + hot-lead alerts + stale-lead AI nudges (2 automations combined)

parameters.content:
## ⚙️ SETUP — step by step
1. Variables: **GEMINI_API_KEY, TG_OWNER_CHAT_ID, BRAND_NAME**. Attach Telegram + Sheets credentials; replace REPLACE_SHEET_ID.
2. Uses the same **Enquiries** tab as B1·1 (Date, Type, Source, Item, Amount/Budget, Customer, Phone, FollowUp, Status). Add a column **Score** (leave blank; the AI fills a copy in Telegram — write back manually or add a Sheets-update node).

## HOW IT RUNS
• Daily 09:30 — all open leads → Gemini scores 1-10 on buying intent (bridal + budget + recent = hot). Score ≥ 8 → 🔥 instant hot-lead alert with a suggested next action.
• Daily 16:00 — leads untouched 4+ days (not Sold/Lost, FollowUp in the past) → Gemini writes a personalised, non-pushy WhatsApp nudge for each → wa.me links to your Telegram. One tap to send.

## WHY IT WORKS
Bridal buyers research 3-6 months — a warm, personal nudge at the right time beats any discount. The AI personalises by item, occasion and budget.

## 🔧 FIX
• Weird scores → give Gemini more signal: fill Item/Budget/Occasion columns.
• Too many nudges → raise the stale threshold in 'Stale leads'.
